notes.title: News & Thank You!
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!

We'd like to express our immense gratitude for the reception of [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b]! 
The love we have received from all of you in these 24 hours since release has been beyond our wildest imagination. ːfofino2ː

Thank you! You are pawsome! ːcathspawː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GDp17PN.jpeg[/img] [i]Leo is speechless[/i]

We're working hard to make the [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b] experience even better for all of you.

Here are the latest updates and bug fixes we’ve made:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Achievements: The 'Perfectionist' achievement bug has been fixed.
[*] Screen Freeze: The issue causing the screen to freeze has been resolved.
[*] Hitboxes: Several hitboxes have been improved.
[*] Typos: Various typos have been fixed.
[*] Tower Base: The bug that sometimes caused players to return to the base of the tower when exiting a room has been fixed.[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*] Metal Detector: The metal detector now starts activated, and you can toggle it on or off by clicking the item in the pause menu.
[*] Home Button: A home button has been added to the pause menu for easier navigation.
[*] 2x Cursor: You can now set the game cursor to be twice the normal size.[/list]

Additionally, we have submitted [b]Trading Cards[/b] and new shop items to Steam for approval, so keep an eye out! ːwinkycatː

And if you still haven't had your share of Devcats games, please check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961160/Cats_Love_Boxes/][b]Cats Love Boxes[/b][/url], a game we are immensely proud of. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961160/Cats_Love_Boxes/

We highly recommend diving into it after completing [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b].

Thank you for your continued support. ːfofinoː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Leo is waiting you!
notes.notes:
Hey there, hoomans!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FAksBKk.png[/img]

I'm Leo, and I need your help on this grand adventure! My internship is hanging by a thread here, but if [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b] succeeds, I'll get a permanent spot with The Devcats!!! ːemotionalcatː 

This is our biggest game yet, with over 1400 cats to find and 70 achievements to unlock. That's a whole 1000 cats more than we had in [b]A Building Full of Cats[/b].
I guess that's what happens when you like traveling through time too much. ːwadacatː

So purrlease, help me secure my place among The Devcats! 
Your support means the world to me, and I can't wait for you to explore this amazing tower. 
Let's make this journey unforgettable! ːwrycatː

See you tomorrow!

Purrs and love bites,
Leo

notes.title: A Vertical Adventure
notes.notes:
Hello, hoomans!

Mr. Fofiño here! ːfofinoː
[img]https://i.imgur.com/y5ffzs4.png[/img]

As we get closer to the release date, I start to reminisce about the first ideas we had for [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b] two years ago. 
The initial concept was very simple: first, we had a Building, then a Castle, so what about a Tower next?
It was a very abstract idea that pushed us to imagine how mankind's history would be seen through the eyes of cats! ːwadacatː

We definitely went "high-concept" with this one, and it certainly gave us some headaches trying to fit all our ideas into this Tower. It ended up becoming quite a big tower for us to climb too! ːawkwardsmileː

In [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b] we've taken everything you loved about our "Full of Cats" games and expanded it into a multi-layered adventure, with intricate puzzles and hidden secrets. 
And now, this process comes full circle! As you may know we're working on the sequel to our first hidden object game! 
Check out [b]A Building Full of Cats 2[/b] coming later this year! ːfofino2ː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2
[h3][b]Wishlist now![/b][/h3]

2 days left!!!

Love and purrs,
Mr. Fofiño

notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans! ːcathspawː

We know you've been eagerly awaiting the release of [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b], and we come bearing some exciting updates!

First and foremost, we want to thank you immensely for your support and patience. Over the past few months, we've been working tirelessly to deliver a game that is truly special to us.

However, as sometimes happens, we've had to deal with some unexpected detours. Unfortunately, cats are easily distracted, and since we are handling many projects (some yet unannounced ːwinkycatː), a delay was inevitable!

Additionally, we decided to redo some of the scenarios to ensure that the experience of [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b] is the best possible. ːfofinoː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3um8XKr.png[/img]
[i]Prehistory before and after[/i]

But now we finally have a release date! [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b] will be released on [b]May 20th[/b]. We're working hard to ensure that every aspect of the game is perfect, and we want to make the wait worth it! ːfofino2ː

We are immensely grateful for your continued support on this journey. We're very excited to share [b]A Tower Full of Cats[/b] with you soon! 

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: FREE GAME: An Arcade Full of Cats
notes.notes:
[h2]FREE GAME ALERT! [/h2]

Attention, humans!

Introducing "An Arcade Full of Cats," our latest creation! Follow the link below to embark on a purrfect adventure and wishlist the game to spread the feline word far and wide! ːfofinoː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368470/An_Arcade_Full_of_Cats/

Step into the golden age of arcades alongside Fofiño and Leo, as they venture through this cat-tastic journey. Our mission is to transform Leo into a true Devcat, and rewrite history to give cats the glory they truly deserve! ːfofino2ː

The game will be about the same size as "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969080/A_Building_Full_of_Cats/]A Building Full of Cats[/url]" and, like always, there"ll be some surprises along the way. 

Rest assured, this game won't delay the launch of "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179170/A_Tower_Full_of_Cats/]A Tower Full of Cats[/url]," as its artwork is already complete. Exciting news about "Tower" are coming soon, so stay tuned!


[h2]Cat Awareness Sale on August 8[/h2] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fjove8U.png[/img]

Mark your calendars for a special event on August 8th – International Cat Day! This meaningful day, established in 2002 by the International Fund for Animal Welfare, serves to raise awareness about cats and ways to protect and support them. ːcathspawː

Here at DEVCATS, we're deeply committed to cat advocacy and promoting feline adoption through our games. To honor our furry friends, we've prepared an incredible sale on Steam, uniting many PAWSOME participants who share the love for cats in all their forms and styles.

Help us make a difference and celebrate the greatness of cats together! Let's create a brighter future for our feline companions.  ːwinkycatː

See you soon!

Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: The Great Cat Search!
notes.notes:
📢 Calling all cat lovers! ːlovecatː Don't miss out on an exciting update for our game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2070550/A_Castle_Full_of_Cats/]A CASTLE FULL OF CATS[/url], this Sunday, July 2, at 10AM Pacific Time!

🔍 We're adding a hidden cat to the game, but this feline won't be easy to find. It will be lurking in plain sight, without appearing on the counter or being detectable with the crystal ball. The challenge is on!

🗝️ To participate and stand a chance to win, make sure you have a save file with all rooms unlocked. This sneaky cat could be hiding anywhere within the castle! To claim the prize, you must be the first to post a picture of the hidden cat on our [url=https://discord.gg/rr8zmYk9VH]Discord server[/url]. Head over to the dedicated competition channel (#NPC-Challenge) and share the screenshot of your discovery. Remember, speed and accuracy are key!

🏆 The best part? The lucky winner will have their very own cat featured in our future game! Imagine seeing your furry friend immortalized in the world of our next game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179170/A_Tower_Full_of_Cats/]A TOWER FULL OF CATS[/url].

🚀 Don't waste a moment! Mark your calendars for this Sunday, July 2, at 10AM Pacific Time, and be ready to dive into the hunt for the hidden cat. Get ready for another unforgettable adventure in A CASTLE FULL OF CATS!

Love & Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Devlog - Dynamic Soundtrack

Thank you so much for everyone who played and wishlisted the game! 

We want to make every game in this series with its own story, setting and game feel.
On A Tower Full of Cats you will climb an enormous tower through the whole history of the world.

One of our biggest ambitions with this game is the soundtrack. The game only has one theme, and that theme changes to fit your current position in history.

Here's a small sample with 4 variations of the main theme:

[previewyoutube=w4_700VO42E;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, some of the rooms inside the tower will have their own special variations. ːcathspawː

Development is going well but we don't have a release window yet, so stay tuned! ːwinkycatː

See you again, soon! 
Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
